Large clearly separated document silhouettes, strong raking warm dusk light, detailed paper fibers, no phone, no money, no banking logos. All document lines abstract illegible ink, NO letters, NO numbers, no UI. Main papers occupy 85% of picture; a focused composition recognizable as paired same-case paperwork at thumbnail scale.
